1- Customer Avatar - no dataset to add
The purpose of a Customer Avatar is to give focus to the MVP that is being tested. As can be seen from our related successful projects in this space in F7, F8, F9 and F10 and in our proposal for this programme, our customer avatar development has been part of that process. 

A customer avatar (also known as a buyer persona or ideal client profile) is a detailed, semi-fictional profile of the single person who represents our ideal customer. So instead of targeting a broad demographic like "women aged 25–40," a customer avatar personifies the target audience into one specific individual - giving them a name, job title, backstory, goals, and daily frustrations. This allows for both a qualitative perspective, to elicit the attitudes and context of the target group and a quantitative aspect of potential cohorts behaviours and attitudes being evidenced during the programme.
